name: ZeNote
title_zh: 七件套一次装齐，笔记从采集到回看全包圆
tagline_zh: 不是单个技能，是七个互相咬合的齿轮。你只管丢素材进来，它自己分类、提炼、排期、提醒回看，笔记不再吃灰。
tagline_en: Not one skill but seven interlocking gears. Feed it raw material; it sorts, distills, schedules, and reminds. No.
why_zh: 七件技能共享一套笔记心智模型，装一个等于装一套工作流。省去逐个挑选、调试、拼装的折腾，开箱即用。
why_en: Seven skills share one note-taking mental model. Install one, get a whole workflow. No picking, tuning, or assembling—just works.
limit_zh: 只适配 ZeNote 自己的笔记体系，不兼容 Obsidian/Notion 等其他库。装完需按内置模板迁移现有笔记。
limit_en: Only works with ZeNote's own note system; not for Obsidian/Notion. Requires migrating existing notes to its templates first.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 7-skill pack: capture to review, notes never rot
